candidates.tagline: Autonomous taxi designed to pick you up — also designed to door you on the way in
candidates.story: Tesla's Cybercab robotaxi, which launched paid rides in Austin in September 2026, has automatic butterfly doors that open without stopping when someone stands in their blind spot, so the car will cheerfully bump a bystander on its way to being helpful.
candidates.why_funny: An autonomous vehicle whose entire pitch is 'we removed the human error' solved the door problem by removing the human — and the door-won't-hit-you part.
candidates.alt: Tesla Cybercab parked at Santana Row, photographed from the side showing the sleek two-door autonomous robotaxi body with its distinctive butterfly door design and no steering wheel visible through the windscreen

candidates.tagline: US Space Force: 'Our new uniform is inspired by Starship Troopers' — the anti-fascist satire
candidates.story: President Trump posted a Truth Social graphic on September 7, 2026 proposing new Space Force 'next generation' uniforms — dark peaked caps, leather boots, silver belt buckles — explicitly stating they were 'inspired by the discipline and functionality of the Starship Trooper uniform,' the 1997 film director Paul Verhoeven made as a deliberate satire of fascism using Nazi propaganda aesthetics.
candidates.why_funny: The US military asked for menacing sci-fi villain uniforms, cited an anti-fascist satire as their reference, and the film's director immediately noted the design was originally based on Leni Riefenstahl's Nazi propaganda films — making the inspiration loop complete.
candidates.alt: AI-generated graphic posted by Donald Trump on Truth Social showing proposed US Space Force Guardian ceremonial uniforms: Space Force members in dark grey fitted jackets, matching trousers, peaked caps, black boots, and silver belt buckles bearing the Space Force delta insignia
candidates.credit: Newsweek / Donald Trump via Truth Social
